Please take this proposal to [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) for approval before opening a feature issue; that is the project's process for new features. For a local workaround, the [custom highlighter docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/highlighting.rst) show how to add regex patterns with `RegexHighlighter`. Related number-highlighting request: #3318.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
